pasākha.cp: neut. the body where it branches from the trunk.
pasākha.p: [ pa + sākha. Prasākha-saṃ ] (pu,na) Google Translate (1) Between the trees. (2) difficult Two thighs below the belly button, the place where it is not difficult. Below the belly button, above the knee, the lower body. (3) It is not difficult. (For the hands, feet, and head, the flesh is a branch, and the five branches are formed.

C: pasākha：[nt．] the body where it branches from the trunk．
pasākhā，（f．） a small branch or twig．
P: Pasākha，（m．& nt．） [pa+sākhā； Epic Sk．praśākhā branch] 1．a smaller branch J．VI，324 （sākha°）．-- 2．branch-like wood，i．e．hard wood Th．1，72．-- 3．the body where it branches off from the trunk，i．e．abdomen & thighs； the lower part of the body Vin．IV，316 （=adho-nābhi ubbha-jānu-maṇḍalaṁ C．）．Cp．Suśruta II．31，10．‹-› 4．the extremities （being the 5th stage in the formation of the embryo） S．I，206．（Page 446）

DOP: pasākha m.n. , mfn. and ~ā, f. [ cf S. praśākha, praśākhā], 1. ( m.n. ) the lower part of the body (between the navel and the knees); Vin IV 316, 4 (aññatarā bhikkhunī ~e jātaṃ gaṇḍaṃ purisena saddhiṃ eken’ ekā bhedāpesi; 316, 22 : ~aṃ nāma adhonābhi ubbhajānumaṇḍalaṃ; Sp 939, 18 : ~e ti adhokāye, adhokāyo hi yasmā tato rukkhassa sākhā viya ubho ūrū pabhijjitvā gatā tasmā ~o ti vuccati); Vin-vn 2346; — 2. ( f. ) a smaller branch; Mhv 18:49 (sahassaṃ tu ~ānaṃ sākhānaṃ tāsaṃ asi ca); — ifc see sākhā-; — pasākhā in Ee at Ja V 450, 24* is wr : read sabbitthiyo kaṇṭakānaṃ va sākhā with Be, Ce, Se; — 3. ( m. ) a small protuberance (marking the fifth stage in the formation of a human embryo); S I 206, 13* (ghanā ~ā jāyanti; Spk I 301, 22 foll.: pañcame sattāhe dvinnaṃ hatthapādānaṃ sīsassa c’ atthāya pañca piḷakā jāyanti); — 4. ( mfn. ) having branches, branched; ? — °- jāta , mfn. , become branched, with branches; ? Th 72 (yathā kaḷīro susu vaḍḍhitaggo dunnikkhamo hoti ~o; Th-a I 172, 5 foll.: jātapasākho, sākhānaṃ pi pabbe pabbe uppanna-anusākho … yathā vaṃso … vaṃsantaresu sampattasākhāpasākho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se saṃsaṭṭhasākhāpasākho); Ja IV 449, 23* (daḷhasmi mūle … dunikkhayo veḷu ~o).

pāsaka.cp: neut. a sling; a snare; a button hole. (m.) a die; a throw.
pāsaka.p: [ pasa + ṇvu. Pasati aṭṭhapadādīsubādhati phusati cāti hi pāsako, catubbī-satividho akkho. Sī,ṭī,saca.1.361. ] (pu,na) Google Translate (1)(a) Kampa ring; A hanger for attaching a belt to the edge of the robe. (b) hanger (simple). (2) dice board Vomiting Zel. (3) Harp hand.

C: pāsaka：[nt．] a sling； a snare； a button hole．（m．） a die； a throw．
P: Pāsaka，<sup>1</sup> [fr．pāsa1] a bow，for the dress Vin．II，136； for the hair Th．2，411 （if Morris，J．P．T．S．1893，45，46，is right to be corr．fr．pasāda）．（Page 456）
